# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_EXTENDED_3DTE

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** watcher_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE of the vwap_continuation signal (currently 0DTE) to 3DTE (and 4DTE) will continue the monotone increase in OOS exp/tr observed from 0DTE to 2DTE due to lower theta on entry, and the edge_capture on J anchor days will increase sufficiently to clear the OP-16 gate (edge_capture >= 771).

## Mechanism

Same vwap_continuation signal (first morning bar ≤10:30 ET that continues in-trend after first 3 RTH closes on same side of session VWAP), but now using 3DTE and 4DTE ITM-2 options from the OP-16 options_3dte/4dte backfill (~8,090 calls). Entry at next bar open, chart-stop-primary doctrine (-8% stop), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, trail 0.15), and 15:50 ET time stop apply. Exit logic unchanged: TP1 at +50% (sell 2/3), runner to breakeven after TP1, and runner exit on ribbon re-entry or +200% premium or time stop.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on ITM-2 3DTE premium ~$1.00? actual to be measured).
2. **Sample bias:** Using OP-16 options_3dte/4dte backfill (~8,090 calls) which covers the period 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18. Sample size is sufficient for OOS exp/tr estimation but may have selection bias if the backfill is not uniformly distributed across time. Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward testing.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will compute walk-forward held-out window after backtest).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will check top 3 J days against real OPRA fills).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential large loss if gap against position; max drawdown: to be measured; blow-up scenario: sustained adverse move triggering -8% stop repeatedly.
6. **Concentration:** To be measured after backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X).

## Pre-merge gate

We require:
- Stage-1 backtest on options_3dte/4dte backfill to compute OOS exp/tr for 3DTE and 4DTE.
- Walk-forward OOS positive and WF ratio >= 0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (diff < ±20% from BS sim).
- Anchor edge_capture >= 771 to clear OP-16 gate.
- Monotone trend check: OOS exp/tr for 3DTE > 2DTE and for 4DTE > 3DTE (if 4DTE is tested).

## Confidence

7 / 10 -- Based on the monotone increase from 0DTE to 2DTE (+82%), we expect 3DTE to continue the trend but note potential diminishing returns or theta decay effects at longer DTE.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This candidate complements the existing WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (ranked ★★) by extending the DTE study to 3DTE and 4DTE. It does not conflict with any existing candidates as it is a pure DTE extension study. It may inform future DTE override wiring proposals.
